story.originalTitle: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Dutch GP
story.summaryEn: Lando Norris won his second consecutive F1 race at the 2025 Dutch Grand Prix, showing McLaren's strong resurgence, and began closing the gap to Kimi Antonelli in the championship.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛的五个快速要点
兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）连续赢得第二场F1分站冠军，证实了迈凯伦速度的提升——而基米·安东内利（安东内利）以第二名成绩扩大了积分榜领先优势
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利（安东内利），梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔），梅赛德斯；兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯），迈凯伦
诺里斯和迈凯伦依然势头强劲、状态正佳
兰多·诺里斯(诺里斯)是最不需要别人提醒他锦标赛下半场会发生什么的人。就在2025年他遭遇最心碎一幕的赛场——当时一次退赛让诺里斯的冠军梦看似彻底破灭——如今这位卫冕冠军再次成为了追赶者，他利用升级后的迈凯伦赛车开始不断蚕食基米·安东内利(安东内利)的领先优势。
诺里斯在匈牙利拿下本赛季首胜后，又在荷兰站夺得杆位，尽管迈凯伦在冲刺中的长距离节奏相对较差，这让人们对正赛的期望有所降温。
在混乱的开局阶段，诺里斯在第2圈静态重启时把领先位置丢给了安东内利。但凭借软胎，这位英国车手始终保持在可攻击范围内，并且当领跑者们换上硬胎后，他看起来势不可挡。
在第72圈中的第54圈，诺里斯在1号弯从外侧包抄了正在防守的安东内利，随后在直道尾段超越了尚未进站的刘易斯·汉密尔顿(汉密尔顿)拿下领先，并轻松保持这一位置直到终点。
诺里斯连续第二场获胜后，他与安东内利之间的差距从90分缩小到83分，但这仍然是一个巨大的优势。不过，很少有人会否认这位26岁的车手正处于极佳状态，同时迈凯轮的滚动式赛车研发已使其MCL40成为一匹潜在的常胜战车。梅赛德斯什么时候才能拿出自己的升级包来应对呢？
劳森充分利用了他突然回归红牛的机会
我们无法确定，但如果利亚姆·劳森（劳森）曾希望在去年中国大奖赛——赛季仅两站之后——被告知将失去红牛席位后，生活有朝一日能再给他一次与马克斯·维斯塔潘作为队友同场竞技的机会，这也不足为奇。
大约一年半之后，他通过在 小红牛 的强势回归重塑了自己的声誉，当伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕受伤缺阵时，这个机会到来了，而劳森牢牢抓住了它。
他在周五稳扎稳打，但在周六的排位赛中大放异彩——考虑到红牛2026年赛车的实际情况——表现出色地拿下第八位，紧随Verstappen之后，仅相差0.115秒。诚然，赞德沃特是一条相对较短的赛道，但在今年被Verstappen在排位赛中击败的12次中，Hadjar此前只有三次能把差距缩小到这个范围之内。
Arvid Lindblad，小红牛车队；劳森，红牛 比赛车队。
Verstappen在起步后不久发生撞车，这让Lawson成为红牛阵营的领军人物。虽然他无法匹敌前六名的速度，但这位新西兰车手完成了一场扎实的比赛，以孤独的第七名完赛。
这不会为他赢得重返红牛的永久席位，他在小红牛的2027年前景也仍不确定。但Lawson充分利用了他意外的第二次机会——或许只是刚刚让自己重新进入了其他车队的视野。
角田裕毅在出人意料的F1回归中与前十名擦肩而过
在红牛车队再次面对维斯塔潘对劳森来说是项艰巨任务，但角田裕毅面临的挑战更为艰难。
作为替补车手代替劳森出战小红牛，这位替补车手从未驾驶过2026年规格的F1赛车，这种赛车在各个方面都与去年的截然不同——尤其是在全新的能量管理要求方面。
不出所料，角田在周末唯一一次自由练习赛中落后于表现出色的新秀队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德超过十分之八秒，但他在冲刺排位赛中逐渐将差距缩小到约十分之四秒，在正赛排位赛中则缩小到百分之一秒至十分之一秒之间。
这位日本车手随后从第12位发车完成了一场令人信服的比赛。他似乎没有犯任何错误，即使需要应对两次静止起步，并且在冲过方格旗时以令人惊叹的超越动作超过阿尔派车队的加斯利，最终获得第11名。
Lindblad因在黄旗状态下违规早早吃到了一次穿越维修区处罚，这使得两者之间的比较变得困难，但Tsunoda仍然表现出色，如果Hadjar的康复进程恰好比计划慢的话，看看他如何看待可能获得的第二次出场机会将会很有意思。
Verstappen撞车后，荷兰大奖赛再无童话般的结局
曾几何时，Verstappen在荷兰大奖赛上获胜就像英超球队对阵第四级别联赛球队必胜一样板上钉钉。这位红牛车手在2021年至2023年期间在他的主场大奖赛上连续三次夺冠，在那段Verstappen统治的时期里，没有什么能够阻挡他。
但随后迈凯伦（迈凯伦）到来，分别由诺里斯（Norris）和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）在2024年和2025年终结了这一连胜纪录，而2026年为维斯塔潘提供了最后一次再度品味主场胜利的机会，因为赞德沃特（Zandvoort）即将从F1赛历中退出。
红牛车队荷兰车手马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）撞毁的赛车
然而童话般的结局并未上演，因为维斯塔潘在第一圈就在“橙色军团”面前撞车了。这位四届世界冠军反正也从未真正具备竞争力，他在冲刺赛中仅排名第六，周日的正赛从第七位发车。
他认为这条赛道暴露了小红牛22的弱点，这座海边赛场让赛车出现了平衡问题。这不会是他所希望的，因为一方面这是他的主场比赛，另一方面这也是他签署新合同的周末。
Verstappen现在还有11次机会，阻止2026年成为他自2016年加入红牛以来第一个没有分站冠军的赛季。
Honda的新引擎不足以点燃阿斯顿·马丁的复兴
在夏休期前的匈牙利站进行重大赛车升级之后，这支位于银石的车队曾希望Honda的新动力单元能带来与底盘看起来同样大的进步。然而，很快情况就变得很清楚：Honda在2026年初以最差的引擎起步后，借助ADUO的帮助开发的升级版动力单元并不是一次重大改进，阿隆索和斯特罗尔都在冲刺赛排位赛和排位赛的第一节被淘汰。
车手们和Adrian Newey在周六很快把功劳归于底盘的改进，同时承认动力单元方面仍需取得更多进展。Stroll尤其直言不讳，直接表示车队缺乏大量动力，而Honda自己也承认，要给车手们带来他们所需的信心，还有很多工作要做。
替代策略加上极低的轮胎衰竭，使Alonso在比赛的大部分时间里都能处于积分区内，事实上，他也借此取得了今年第一个在赛道上获得的前十名成绩。正如这位西班牙车手所指出的，阿斯顿·马丁此前距离前方还很远，但即便有了这个强劲的成绩和一台看起来确实有所改进的底盘，引擎仍然是车队的薄弱环节，而且目前来看，这台引擎似乎还无法帮助这支绿色车队实现大幅反弹。
detailEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Dutch GP
Lando Norris won his second F1 race in a row, confirming McLaren's improved pace - while Kimi Antonelli stretched his championship lead by finishing second
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes, Lando Norris, McLaren
Norris and McLaren are still alive and well

Lando Norris is the last person who needs a reminder of what can happen in the second half of the championship. On the scene of his worst heartbreak in 2025, when Norris' championship looked dead and buried after a retirement, the defending champion is now the hunter once more after using an upgraded McLaren to start chipping away at the lead of Kimi Antonelli.
Norris backed up a first win of the campaign in Hungary with pole in the Netherlands, though McLaren's comparatively poor long run pace in the sprint dampened expectations in the grand prix proper.

In a chaotic opening phase, Norris lost his lead to Antonelli on lap 2's standing restart. But on soft tyres, the Briton stayed within striking distance and looked imperious once the frontrunners switched to the hard compound.

On lap 54 of 72 Norris swept around the outside of a defending Antonelli into Turn 1, before dispatching Lewis Hamilton - who had yet to stop - on the back straight to take the lead of the race, which he would comfortably retain until the finish.

Norris' second consecutive win brought his gap to Antonelli down from 90 to 83 points, which is still a huge margin. But few will argue the 26-year-old has hit a rich vein of form, while McLaren's rolling car development has turned its MCL40 into a potential serial winner. When will Mercedes be able to respond with its own upgrade package?
Lawson made the most of his sudden Red Bull return

We can’t know for certain, but it would hardly be surprising if Liam Lawson had hoped that, after being told he would lose his Red Bull seat following last year’s Chinese Grand Prix, just two races into the season, life might one day give him another chance to measure himself against Max Verstappen as his team-mate.

Almost a year and a half later, and having rebuilt his reputation with a strong return to Racing Bulls, that chance arrived when Isack Hadjar suffered a wrist injury, and Lawson grabbed it with both hands.

He took things steadily on Friday, but came alive on Saturday with an excellent qualifying performance — given the reality of Red Bull’s 2026 car — to take eighth, just behind Verstappen and only 0.115s away. Yes, Zandvoort is a relatively short lap, but Hadjar had only been within that margin of the Dutchman on three occasions this year, across the 12 times he was outqualified by Verstappen.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Red Bull Racing
Verstappen’s crash shortly after the start left Lawson leading Red Bull’s effort. While he couldn’t match the pace of the top six, the New Zealander delivered a solid race to finish a lonely seventh.

It won’t earn him a permanent return to Red Bull, and his Racing Bulls future for 2027 remains uncertain. But Lawson made the most of his unexpected second chance — and may just have put himself back on the radar of other teams.
Yuki Tsunoda narrowly misses top 10 on unexpected F1 return
Going up against Verstappen again at Red Bull was a tall order for Lawson, but Yuki Tsunoda faced an even tougher challenge.

Standing in for Lawson at Racing Bulls, the reserve driver had never driven 2026-spec Formula 1 machinery, which is dramatically different from last year’s in every area – particularly the novel energy management requirements.

Tsunoda unsurprisingly lagged behind impressive rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad by over eight tenths in the weekend’s sole free practice session but gradually reduced his deficit to about four tenths in sprint qualifying and one hundredth to one tenth in the main qualifying session.

The Japanese racer then performed a convincing drive from 12th on the grid. He seemingly didn’t put a foot wrong, even with two standing starts to handle, and performed a breathtaking move on Alpine’s Pierre Gasly on his way to 11th position under the chequered flag.

Lindblad getting a drive-through penalty early on for a yellow-flag infringement makes the comparison difficult, but Tsunoda still did well, and it would be interesting to see what he makes of a potential second outing if Hadjar’s recovery happens to be slower than planned.
No fairytale Dutch GP ending after Verstappen crash

There was once a time where victory at the Dutch Grand Prix for Verstappen seemed as guaranteed as a victory would be for a Premier League side against one from the fourth division. The Red Bull driver won three on the bounce at his home race from 2021 to 2023 and during that period of Verstappen dominance, there was nothing stopping him.

But then came McLaren, who respectively ended that streak in 2024 and 2025 via Norris and Oscar Piastri, yet 2026 offered one final opportunity for Verstappen to once again taste home success as Zandvoort is set to drop off the F1 calendar.
Crashed car of Red Bull Racing's Dutch driver Max Verstappen

Yet the fairytale ending wasn’t to be, as Verstappen crashed on the opening lap in front of the ‘Orange Army’. The four-time world champion was never really in contention anyway, as he finished sixth in the sprint race and started Sunday’s grand prix in seventh.

He reckons the circuit exposed the weaknesses of the RB22, which endured balance problems at the seaside venue. Not what he would have hoped for given, a, it was his home race and also, b, it being the weekend he has signed a new contract.
Verstappen now has 11 more chances to stop 2026 from being his first winless season since joining Red Bull in 2016.
Honda's new engine won't be enough to spark Aston Martin's revival

After Aston Martin's major car upgrade in Hungary just before the summer break, the Silverstone-based team had hoped Honda's new power unit would deliver as big a step forward as the chassis appeared to have made. However, it soon became clear that Honda's updated power unit, developed with the help of the ADUO after starting 2026 with the worst engine, was not a major improvement, with Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll both eliminated in the first stage of the sprint shootout and qualifying.

The drivers and Adrian Newey were quick to point to the chassis improvements on Saturday, while admitting that more progress was still needed on the power unit side. Stroll was particularly candid, saying outright that the team was lacking a lot of power, while Honda itself admitted there was still more work to do to give its drivers the confidence they needed.

The alternative strategy and very low tyre degradation allowed Alonso to run in the points for much of the race and, in fact, secure his first top-10 finish on the road this year. As the Spaniard pointed out, Aston Martin was previously much further away from the front, but even with this strong result and a chassis that appears to have genuinely improved, the engine remains the team's weak point and, for now, does not look capable of enabling a major comeback for the green outfit.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Max Verstappen will have no say in 2027 Racing Bulls driver line-up, says Red Bull boss
relatedItems.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies said Racing Bulls alone will decide its Formula 1 driver line-up for 2027 and that Max Verstappen will have no say, despite Verstappen's contact with Liam Lawson in Mexico.
detailZh: 红牛领队洛朗·梅基斯坚称，维斯塔潘对小红牛2027年的车手阵容没有任何影响力。
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯表示，小红牛2027年的F1车手阵容将完全由小红牛自行决定，尽管马克斯·维斯塔潘在墨西哥与利亚姆·劳森发生了冲突。
维斯塔潘和劳森在第二节练习中发生接触，两人均被罚在墨西哥大奖赛退后一位发车。
面向红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，提供来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术解读与比赛分析。
红牛车队首席执行官兼领队洛朗·梅基斯解释称，2027年F1车手阵容将完全由小红牛自行决定，尽管马克斯·维斯塔潘在墨西哥与利亚姆·劳森发生冲突，但他对此没有发言权。
维斯塔潘和劳森在周五第二节练习赛中发生接触，两人均被处以墨西哥大奖赛正赛发车位退后一位的处罚。
这位四届世界冠军在练习赛结束后对媒体表示，劳森的行为“不太明智”。
“嗯，我不认为这能叫运气不好。也许他当时想做的事不太明智，”这位荷兰人解释道，“我的意思是，归根结底这不会改变我的周末，但如果我是他，我会表现得稍微聪明一点。而且，当你在为自己的席位而战时，这种行为不太明智。”
劳森与红牛姊妹车队的合同将于2026年底到期，但梅基斯坚称维斯塔潘和红牛不会对小红牛车队的车手阵容施加影响。
“不，我认为你知道必须把两方面分开。有些在赛道上的事情非常没有必要，因此让涉及其中的车手感到沮丧，也让涉及其中的车队感到沮丧，这大概就是你们从马克斯的回答中听到的，然后还有车手决定，”梅基斯对天空体育F1说。
“小红牛（车手阵容）由他们决定，而且只由他们决定。”
当被要求澄清维斯塔潘是否会影响小红牛车队的车手决定时，梅基斯补充道：“马克斯对赛车运动了解得太多了，无论如何都不会被单一事件影响。我认为到目前为止我们一直处于落后。”
“其他三支顶尖车队不知怎么地总比我们多榨取了一点性能，但周末还没结束。伙计们一直在为我们能对赛车做的最后一项修改倾尽全力。”
“让我们看看能不能再靠近领先集团一点。今天早上情况很糟的时候，我们大约落后零点三五秒。如果我们能缩小一点这个差距，应该能让我们重新回到竞争行列中。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen will have no say in 2027 Racing Bulls driver line-up, says Red Bull boss
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has insisted Max Verstappen will have no influence over Racing Bulls' 2027 driver line-up
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Liam Lawson, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull Racing CEO and team principal Laurent Mekies has explained that Racing Bulls alone will decide its Formula 1 driver line-up for 2027 and that Max Verstappen will not have a say despite his clash with Liam Lawson in Mexico.
Both Verstappen and Lawson were handed a one-place grid penalty for the Mexican Grand Prix after making contact during the second practice session on Friday.
The four-time champion argued it was "not very smart behaviour" from Lawson while speaking to the media after the session.

"Well, I don't think it's called unlucky. Maybe not very smart behaviour, what he was trying to do there," the Dutchman explained. "I mean, at the end of the day it's not going to change my weekend, but if I were him I would act a little bit smarter. Also, when you're fighting for your seat, it's not very smart behaviour."
Lawson's contract with the Red Bull sister team expires at the end of 2026, but Mekies insisted that Verstappen and Red Bull would have no sway over the Racing Bulls driver line-up.

"No, I think you know you have to separate both aspects. You have some things that were very unnecessary on the track and therefore are frustrating for the drivers involved and frustrating for the teams involved, and this is probably what you hear with Max's answer, and then there are driver decisions," Mekies told Sky Sports F1.
"Racing Bulls [driver line-up is] down to them and only down to them."

When asked to clarify if Verstappen could influence Racing Bulls' driver decisions, Mekies added: "Max knows motorsport far too much to be influenced by a single episode anyway. I think so far we've been on the back foot.
"The other three top teams have been somehow extracting a bit more than us, but the weekend is not finished. The guys have been putting the best shot at the last modification we can do to the car.

"Let's see if we can get a bit closer to the top. When things were very bad this morning, we were about three and a half tenths away. If we can close a bit of that gap, it should put us back in the mix."

detailZh: F1墨西哥大奖赛：兰多·诺里斯以0.001秒的优势领跑最终练习赛
兰多·诺里斯在墨西哥大奖赛的紧张排位赛中险胜基米·安东内利
现世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在F1墨西哥大奖赛的第三场和最后一场练习赛中领跑，在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上，他与车手冠军基米·安东内利在紧张的比赛中的表现不相上下。
诺里斯的成绩仅比安东内利的初始基准低0.001秒，在复杂的超高海拔赛道上，所有四支顶级车队都处于竞争之中，其中一些车队的中场赛车遇到了动力单元问题。
一个平静的开局阶段，Ryo Hirakawa 在哈斯赛车中获得了很多曝光机会。在完成了第一节自由练习后，丰田车队支持的这位车手作为替补回到了哈斯车队，在墨西哥周末剩余的时间里代替了奥康。
奥康 因为一些尚未完全明朗的原因被车队停赛，这位法国人在第二节自由练习中与自己的赛车工程师发生了激烈的争执。
32岁的首秀车手Hirakawa 在困难且滑溜的高海拔阿特罗米奥·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上逐渐建立信心，而冠军热门安东内利 和 勒克莱尔 在练习赛的开局阶段展开了激烈的较量，因为所有的主要竞争者都在使用中性胎。
在第二节自由练习中因为引擎故障错过了宝贵的赛道时间后，汉密尔顿 在比赛进行到一半前以1分18.268秒的成绩脱颖而出，继续延续法拉利车队在周五的初始设置方向。
勒克莱尔再次从队友的圈速中夺走了一十分之一，随后汉密尔顿以1分18秒162的成绩领跑中胎轮胎的练习，勒克莱尔和安东内利紧随其后，而红牛和梅赛德斯车队看起来明显落后。
诺里斯换上软胎后，这位世界冠军车手以1分17秒873的成绩短暂领跑，领先队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和乔治·罗素，乔治·罗素对在福罗索尔赛车场入口处的复杂12号右弯缺乏抓地力表示遗憾。
勒克莱尔在艾塞斯弯道出现失误并减速后，安东内利以1分17秒601的成绩跃升至计时表首位，但在那之前，他对在1号弯被马克斯·维斯塔潘阻挡表示了不满。
安东内利在接下来的飞驰中在一号弯道出现失误，导致他在一号弯道的第一部分速度变慢，但最终并没有提高成绩。这为诺里斯创造了机会，他以仅慢0.001秒的优势超过了安东内利，以本周末最快的成绩进入排位赛。
勒克莱尔在第一区段迅速提升，但仍然保持在第三位，落后0.117秒，紧随其后的是皮亚斯蒂。维斯塔潘以0.351秒的差距排在第五位，他在刹车方面遇到了困难，这为2026年四支顶级车队之间的又一紧张排位赛奠定了基础。
第三区段的不整洁让汉密尔顿落后了超过四分之一秒，排在第六位，随后是拉塞尔和哈德贾，哈德贾称他的红牛赛车是“这周末我开过的最糟糕的赛车，太糟糕了”。
小红牛车队再次看起来在争夺最佳非顶级车队中很有优势，利亚姆·劳森在第九位超过了他的青训车队队友阿维德·林德布拉德，他们完成了前十名。
平川结束了他的练习，排在第19位，略领先于凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特里·博塔斯。奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特莱托在出站圈时遇到了动力单元问题，引擎发出异常声音，冒出一股烟雾。
主场英雄塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯也未能完成一圈，凯迪拉克宣布在排位赛之前将进行一次“预防性引擎更换”。
detailEn: F1 Mexico GP: Lando Norris tops final practice by 0.001s from Kimi Antonelli
Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli ahead of a finely poised Formula 1 qualifying session at the Mexico GP

Reigning world champion Lando Norris has topped third and final practice at Formula 1's Mexico Grand Prix, beating championship leader Kimi Antonelli in a tight session at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
Norris dipped just 0.001s under Antonelli's initial benchmark as all four top teams looked in the mix on the tricky high-altitude circuit, with several midfield running into power unit trouble.

A quiet opening phase saw Ryo Hirakawa get a lot of airtime in the Haas. Having covered FP1, the Toyota-backed driver returned to the Haas as a substitute for Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the Mexico weekend.
Ocon was benched by the squad for reasons which are yet to be fully clarified, with the Frenchman having a heated exchange with his race engineer in FP2.

While 32-year-old debutant Hirakawa was building up confidence around the difficult and slippery, high-altitude Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, champion-elect Antonelli and Charles Leclerc traded blows during the opening stages of the session as all frontrunners were running medium tyres.

Having missed valuable track time in FP2 with engine trouble, Lewis Hamilton came to the fore just before the halfway mark with a 1m18.268s, picking up where Ferrari left off as the squad was satisfied with the initial set-up direction on Friday.

Leclerc took another tenth out of his team-mate's lap time, before Hamilton took top with a 1m18.162s lap to lead the medium-tyre runs that dominated the first half of practice, followed by Leclerc and Antonelli as both Red Bull and McLaren looked a clear step behind.

Bolting on softs, reigning world champion Norris briefly claimed top with a 1m17.873s ahead of team-mate Oscar Piastri and George Russell, who lamented a lack of grip through the tricky Turn 12 right-hander entering the Foro Sol stadium.

As Leclerc got out of shape through the Esses and backed out, Antonelli jumped to the top of the timesheets with a 1m17.601s lap, but not before voicing his frustration at Max Verstappen's impeding in Turn 1.

Antonelli then went purple in sector one on his next flyer but ultimately didn't improve. That opened the door for Norris to pip him by just 0.001s to head into qualifying with the fastest time of the weekend.

Leclerc found a late improvement with a rapid first sector but stayed in third, 0.117s behind, closely followed by Piastri. Verstappen was fifth, 0.351s behind as he struggled with his brakes, setting up another close qualifying session between 2026's four top teams.
An untidy third sector left Hamilton over four tenths adrift in sixth, followed by Russell and Hadjar, who called his Red Bull "the worst car I've driven this weekend, it's terrible".
Racing Bulls again looked well poised to win the best of the rest battle, with Liam Lawson pipping rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad to ninth as they rounded out the top 10.

Hirakawa ended his session in 19th, just ahead of Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas. Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto didn't manage to set a lap time after encountering a power unit issue on his out-lap, with a puff of smoke emanating from an ill-sounding engine.
Home hero Sergio Perez also failed to set a lap, with Cadillac announcing it would have to perform a "precautionary engine change" ahead of qualifying.

relatedItems.originalTitle: When Red Bull expects to start using its long-awaited new F1 wind tunnel
relatedItems.summaryEn: Red Bull has turned its 2026 Formula 1 season around impressively, but its technical team is still limited by the oldest wind tunnel on the F1 grid. Team principal Laurent Mekies offered an indication in Mexico of when Red Bull will actually be able to benefit from its new wind tunnel.
detailZh: 红牛预计何时开始使用期待已久的新F1风洞
维斯塔潘称新风洞是他对2027年抱有额外希望的因素之一。在墨西哥，车队领队洛朗·梅基斯给出了红牛何时才能真正受益于这一新工具的线索。
尽管红牛以令人印象深刻的方式扭转了2026赛季的F1局面，但由皮埃尔·瓦什领导的技术团队在幕后仍要应对多项限制。其中之一或许就是风洞——整个F1围场中最老旧的一座。
前领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳曾多次将红牛的风洞形容为“冷战遗物”，并称在贝德福德附近这座已有70年历史的设施里工作就像在看“两块不同的表”，并强调其相关性不止一次与赛道上的实际情况对不上。
红牛在改进其2026年赛车的过程中似乎几乎没有受到这方面的影响，尽管梅基斯承认，从理论上讲，新设施应该能为车队带来竞争优势。
当被Motorsport.com问及风洞时，梅基斯表示：“我认为你说得对。尽管我们目前使用的风洞在过去几年里最终产出了非凡的成果，但我认为你的评估是对的，它很可能是发车区上最老旧的风洞。”
“因此，如果你跃升到最先进的设施——而车队确实一直在努力设计并现在建造出能让我们在该领域重回第一位置的东西——你当然会期望从中获得竞争优势。”
风洞已成为F1中的一大投资领域。迈凯伦从2010年起使用丰田在科隆的风洞，但自2023年夏天以来已能依靠自己的设施——这显然与车队自那以后的进步有关。
阿斯顿·马丁在其银石园区也拥有一座最先进的风洞，阿德里安·纽维称其为业内最佳，尽管由于其他限制因素，其优势尚未在赛道表现中体现出来。
后者还强调，新风洞并不能立即保证性能提升，通常需要时间才能完全理解这一新工具并挖掘其最大潜力。
“所以，[竞争优势]不会在我们一启动所有设备时就立刻显现，”梅基斯承认。“但它肯定会释放潜力，并为我们空气动力学部门的人才提供另一种表达想法的方式。”
当维斯塔潘提到新风洞是给他2027年信心的不那么明显的因素之一时，他立即明确表示，这自然不会有助于已经启动的小红牛23的初期研发。不过，他补充说，它可能有助于2027年赛车在整个赛季中的进一步研发。
当 Motorsport.com 询问梅基斯，他是否有关于红牛何时才能真正开始使用新风洞的最新消息时——该风洞位于米尔顿凯恩斯园区，因此在后勤方面也更加便利——这位法国人回应道：“就时间线而言，它还没有准备好。它会在下个赛季的某个时候上线。”
“是第一季度、第二季度还是第三季度？我们拭目以待。这将取决于我们首先需要多少时间让它上线，然后再完成校准工作。因此，它很可能将用于 2027 年赛车的后半部分研发，并有望用于 2028 年赛车的大部分研发。”
detailEn: When Red Bull expects to start using its long-awaited new F1 wind tunnel

Max Verstappen has named it one of the factors giving him additional hope for 2027. In Mexico, team principal Laurent Mekies offers an indication of when Red Bull will actually be able to benefit from its new tool

Although Red Bull has turned its 2026 Formula 1 season around in impressive fashion, the technical team led by Pierre Wache is still dealing with several limitations behind the scenes. One of the main ones is perhaps the wind tunnel, the oldest on the entire F1 grid.

Former team principal Christian Horner repeatedly described Red Bull's wind tunnel as "a Cold War relic" and said working with the 70-year-old facility near Bedford was like looking at "two different watches", highlighting that the correlation had more than once failed to match what happened on track.

Red Bull has seemingly suffered little from that while improving its 2026 challenger, although Mekies acknowledges that the new facility should, in theory, provide the team with a competitive advantage.

"I think you're right. As much as the wind tunnel that we are using has ultimately been producing extraordinary results over the last few years, I think you are right in your assessment that it is most likely the oldest one on the grid", Mekies said when asked about the wind tunnel by Motorsport.com.

"As a result, if you jump to a state-of-the-art facility – and the team have really tried to design and now produce something that will put us back at the very first place in that area – of course you expect a competitive advantage from there."

Wind tunnels have become a major area of investment in F1. McLaren used Toyota’s in Cologne from 2010, but has been able to rely on its own facility since the summer of 2023 – something clearly linked to the team’s progress since then.

Aston Martin also has a state-of-the-art wind tunnel on its Silverstone campus, described by Adrian Newey as the best in the business, although the benefits have yet to be reflected in the on-track performances due to other limiting factors.
The latter also underlines that a new wind tunnel does not immediately guarantee an improvement and that it often takes time to fully understand the new tool and extract its maximum potential.

"So, [the competitive advantage] is not going to come up as soon as we switch on everything", Mekies admitted. "But it's certainly going to unlock potential and give the talented people that we have in the aero department another way to express their ideas."

When Verstappen mentioned the new wind tunnel as one of the less obvious factors giving him confidence for 2027, he immediately made clear that it would naturally not help with the initial development of the RB23, which is already under way. However, he added that it could contribute to further development of the 2027 car throughout the season.

When Motorsport.com asked Mekies whether he had an update on when Red Bull would actually be able to start using the new wind tunnel – which is located on the Milton Keynes campus, making things easier logistically as well – the Frenchman responded: "In terms of the timeline, it is not ready yet. It's something that will come online sometime during next season.

"Is it the first quarter, second quarter or third quarter? We will see. It will be based on how much time we need to get it online first, and then also to complete the calibration work. So, it will most likely be for the second part of the 2027 car and hopefully for most of the 2028 car."
